thread_text:
sophie: quick microbench summary for cedar11b int6 vs int8 on A100p4 — slices: short-chat (median 64, p95 180), longform (1024), instructions (32).

akash: good, hit me with the numbers.

sophie: int6 throughput ≈ +85% vs int8 under our batching policy. token-unit cost down ≈ -31%. p50 latency chat up ~+9ms, p95 up ~+40ms for int6.

ben-ml: quality signals?

sophie: ran eval-suite-gtv2 (200 blinded pairs) + targeted math/chain tests (100 examples). human pref: int8 57% / int6 43% (95% CI ±6%). gap largest on multi-step reasoning and exact-match math.

eval-bot: run summary: cedar11b-int8 vs cedar11b-int6 | datasets: eval-suite-gtv2(200), math-chain(100) | pairwise: 57/43 int8 fav | perf: +85% throughput int6, ~-31% token cost.

maria: commercial ask: can we safely route some chat traffic to int6 and claim ~30% unit cost reduction? need guardrails for GTN comms.

akash: infra-wise int6 uses ~+9% GPU DRAM; cold-start KV populate similar. higher concurrency means fewer pods per qps; monitored OOMs = 0 in tests.

sophie: proposal: "fidelity-gating" routing flag with conservative rules:
- default: int8 for premium/fidelity-sensitive routes
- chat-lowcost route: short prompts <=200 tokens -> serve int6, with fast-sync confidence checks and soft fallback to int8
- longform or any prompt >700 tokens -> int8

maria: what do you mean by "fast-sync confidence"?

ben-ml: keep sync check lightweight: last-token entropy threshold + simple repeat/ngram rate. async classifier for deeper checks sampled at low rate.

sophie: proto config snippet:
```
routes:
  - id: chat-lowcost
    max_prompt_tokens: 200
    variants: [cedar11b-int6, cedar11b-int8]
    sync_checks:
      - entropy_last_token < 0.10 -> fallback: cedar11b-int8
      - ngram_repeat_rate > 0.25 -> fallback: cedar11b-int8
    async_checks: classifier_sample_rate: 0.5%
```

tom: entropy calc is cheap (<1ms). classifier call would add ~8-12ms if done inline. keep that async.

sophie: telemetry plan: log token_saved, fallback_reason, fallback_rate, async_classifier_disagreements, human_pref_samples weekly. add a confusion metric = fraction of async classifier triggers that disagree with sync checks.

maria: rollout suggestion?

akash: canary plan:
- start 0.2% users on chat-lowcost
- monitor 72h: fallback_rate <1.5%, token-saved consistent, human_pref delta <3 points on sampled pairs
- ramp to 3% if stable, continuous monitoring thereafter

ben-ml: add automatic weekly blind sample: 200 chat pairs + 100 longform regression-sensitive examples; trigger human-eval queue if weekly delta >4 points or fallback_rate spikes >2%.

sophie: infra note: recommend +10% memory buffer for int6-dedicated pools due to slightly larger working set.

action items:
- @akash: implement telemetry counters (token_saved, fallback_reason, classifier_sample) — due: EOD today
- @tom: update pool allocations with +10% memory buffer for int6 nodes — due: tomorrow
- @ben-ml: wire up weekly blind pairwise sampler & alerting — due: Fri
- @maria: draft public-facing GTN blurb and comms with caveats — due: Wed

maria: ack. sales blurb ask: we want a conservative headline "~30% token-cost reduction on short chat with fidelity gating; small regression risk on complex reasoning". i'll draft.

sophie: created draft PR for routing flag + telemetry: https://git.internal/r/redwood/cedar-routing/pull/318

tom: note for Dedicated customers: recommend opt-in toggle for fidelity gating per-pool. also reserve +10% host memory for int6 variants.

sophie: thanks everyone. reconvene after first canary window and we'll decide next steps. :thumbsup:
